CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_moderation(p_message_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_reason text, p_channel_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE bot_id uuid := '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'; new_count int; is_muted boolean := false; BEGIN INSERT INTO public.messages (channel_id, author_id, content, content_type, parent_id, is_mod) VALUES (p_channel_id, bot_id, p_reason, 'text', p_message_id, true); UPDATE public.profiles SET warning_count = COALESCE(warning_count,0) + 1 WHERE id = p_user_id RETURNING warning_count INTO new_count; IF new_count >= 3 THEN UPDATE public.profiles SET status = 'muted', muted_until = now() + interval '1 day' WHERE id = p_user_id; is_muted := true; END IF; INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, body, link) VALUES (p_user_id, 'warning', CASE WHEN is_muted THEN '你已被禁言1天' ELSE '你被警告了' END, p_reason, '/channel/' || p_channel_id::text); RETURN jsonb_build_object('warning_count', new_count, 'muted', is_muted); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.block_privileged_role_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ BEGIN IF (current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json->>'role') = 'service_role' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF (OLD.role IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.role) THEN IF NOT public.is_admin() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission denied: only an administrator may change profile role' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_claim(p_msg uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bobo_reply_log WHERE trigger_msg_id = p_msg AND kind = 'claim') = 0$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_log(p_kind text, p_ok boolean DEFAULT true, p_model text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_channel uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_author uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_msg uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ INSERT INTO public.bobo_reply_log (kind, ok, model, note, channel_id, author_id, trigger_msg_id) VALUES (p_kind, p_ok, p_model, p_note, p_channel, p_author, p_msg); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_memory_decay()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ UPDATE public.bobo_memories SET weight = GREATEST(weight * 0.5, 0.1) WHERE last_seen < now() - interval '180 days'; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_memory_match(p_query vector, p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_channel uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_match_count integer DEFAULT 3)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, scope text, content text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT m.id, m.scope, m.content, 1 - (m.embedding <=> p_query) AS similarity FROM public.bobo_memories m WHERE m.embedding IS NOT NULL AND m.weight > 0.15 AND (m.scope = 'global' OR (m.scope = 'user' AND m.user_id = p_user) OR (m.scope = 'channel' AND m.channel_id = p_channel)) ORDER BY m.embedding <=> p_query LIMIT GREATEST(p_match_count, 1); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_memory_upsert(p_scope text, p_content text, p_embedding vector, p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_channel uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_weight real DEFAULT 1.0)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_id bigint; BEGIN IF p_scope NOT IN ('user','channel','global') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bad scope'; END IF; IF length(btrim(p_content)) = 0 OR length(p_content) > 400 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bad content'; END IF; SELECT id INTO v_id FROM public.bobo_memories WHERE scope = p_scope AND ((p_scope='user' AND user_id = p_user) OR (p_scope='channel' AND channel_id = p_channel) OR p_scope='global') LIMIT 1; IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE public.bobo_memories SET content = left(p_content, 400), embedding = p_embedding, weight = p_weight, last_seen = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = v_id; RETURN v_id; END IF; INSERT INTO public.bobo_memories (scope, user_id, channel_id, content, embedding, weight) VALUES (p_scope, p_user, p_channel, left(p_content,400), p_embedding, p_weight) RETURNING id INTO v_id; RETURN v_id; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_rate_check()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bobo_reply_log WHERE kind='reply' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') < 40 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bobo_reply_log WHERE kind='reply' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') < 200; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_send(p_channel_id uuid, p_content text, p_parent_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_bot uuid := public.bobo_uid(); v_new_id uuid; v_ch_type text; BEGIN IF v_bot IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bobo account missing'; END IF; SELECT type INTO v_ch_type FROM public.channels WHERE id = p_channel_id; IF v_ch_type = 'announcement' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bobo cannot post in announcement'; END IF; IF p_content IS NULL OR length(btrim(p_content)) = 0 OR length(p_content) > 2000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bobo content invalid'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.messages (channel_id, author_id, content, content_type, parent_id) VALUES (p_channel_id, v_bot, btrim(p_content), 'text', p_parent_id) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id; RETURN v_new_id; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bobo_uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE username = 'bobo' LIMIT 1; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_users()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, username text, nickname text, avatar_url text, email text, role text, status text, registered_at timestamp with time zone, warning_count integer, muted_until timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$ SELECT p.id, p.username, p.nickname, p.avatar_url, u.email, p.role, p.status, u.created_at, p.warning_count, p.muted_until FROM public.profiles p LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON p.id = u.id WHERE public.is_admin() ORDER BY u.created_at DESC NULLS LAST; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_blocklist()
 RETURNS TABLE(word text, category text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$ SELECT word, category FROM public.blocklist WHERE enabled = true ORDER BY category, word; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_stats()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$ WITH tz AS ( SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS today_start ) SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'userCount', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles), 'channelCount', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.channels), 'msgCount', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages), 'msgToday', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages, tz WHERE created_at >= tz.today_start), 'trend', ( SELECT jsonb_agg(t ORDER BY t->>'date') FROM ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'date', to_char((tz.today_start - (g || ' days')::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages m WHERE m.created_at >= tz.today_start - (g || ' days')::interval AND m.created_at < tz.today_start - ((g - 1) || ' days')::interval) ) AS t FROM tz, generate_series(6, 0, -1) AS g ) sub ), 'recent', ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(r), '[]'::jsonb) FROM ( SELECT m.content, m.created_at, m.channel_id, p.nickname, p.username, c.name AS channel_name FROM public.messages m LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = m.author_id LEFT JOIN public.channels c ON c.id = m.channel_id WHERE COALESCE(m.is_mod, false) = false ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 6 ) r ) ); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_flagged_posts()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, content text, content_type text, is_pinned boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, channel_id uuid, author_id uuid, reviewed boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$ SELECT m.id, m.content, m.content_type, m.is_pinned, m.created_at, m.channel_id, m.author_id, COALESCE(m.reviewed, false) FROM public.messages m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.messages c WHERE c.parent_id = m.id AND c.is_mod = true) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$ BEGIN INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, username, nickname, role, status) VALUES (NEW.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(NEW.email, '@.*$', ''), 'user_' || substring(NEW.id::text, 1, 8)), 'user'), split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1), 'student', 'active') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND role = 'admin'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_channel_member(ch uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.channel_members
    WHERE channel_id = ch AND user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_dm(p_message_id uuid, p_author_id uuid, p_channel_id uuid, p_friend_id uuid, p_content text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_name text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(nickname, username, '有人') INTO v_name FROM profiles WHERE id = p_author_id;
  INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, body, link, is_read)
  VALUES (
    p_friend_id,
    'dm',
    v_name || ' 给你发了私信',
    COALESCE(left(p_content, 80), ''),
    '/dm/' || p_channel_id::text || '/' || p_friend_id::text,
    false
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.publish_notification_realtime()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM realtime.publish(
    'notifications:' || NEW.user_id::text,
    'new_notification',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'record', jsonb_build_object(
        'id',         NEW.id,
        'user_id',    NEW.user_id,
        'type',       NEW.type,
        'title',      NEW.title,
        'body',       NEW.body,
        'link',       NEW.link,
        'is_read',    NEW.is_read,
        'created_at', NEW.created_at
      )
    )
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.respond_friend_request(p_friendship_id uuid, p_action text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_me uuid := auth.uid(); v_row public.friends; v_nick text; BEGIN SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.friends WHERE id = p_friendship_id AND friend_id = v_me; IF v_row.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','notfound'); END IF; IF v_row.status = 'accepted' THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'msg','already_accepted'); END IF; IF p_action = 'accept' THEN UPDATE public.friends SET status='accepted' WHERE id = p_friendship_id; SELECT nickname INTO v_nick FROM public.profiles WHERE id = v_me; INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, body, link, is_read) VALUES (v_row.user_id, 'friend_accepted', COALESCE(v_nick,'对方') || ' 已接受你的好友申请', '', '', false); ELSE DELETE FROM public.friends WHERE id = p_friendship_id; END IF; DELETE FROM public.notifications WHERE type = 'friend_request' AND link = '/friends/request?id=' || p_friendship_id::text; RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true); END; $function$
